name: Perth Alexithymia Questionnaire - Short Form
time_window_text: Please indicate how much you agree or disagree with each statement.

items.text: When I am feeling bad (feeling an unpleasant emotion), I can't find the right words to describe those feelings.
When I am feeling bad (feeling an unpleasant emotion), I am confused about what emotion I am feeling.
When I am feeling good (feeling a pleasant emotion), I can't find the right words to describe those feelings.
When I am feeling good (feeling a pleasant emotion), I am confused about what emotion I am feeling.
I prefer to just let things happen rather than to understand why they turned out that way.
I tend to ignore how I feel.

band_descriptions.low_alexithymia: Your responses indicate low levels of difficulty in perceiving and experiencing emotions. Most people experience this occasionally, and your responses fall within the typical, healthy range of emotional awareness.
band_descriptions.moderate_alexithymia: Your responses suggest moderate challenges with identifying or describing your emotions. Many people find it helpful to monitor this and gently practice tuning into their feelings.
band_descriptions.high_alexithymia: Your responses indicate a high level of difficulty in identifying and describing emotions. Exploring these patterns further can be very beneficial for understanding how you process emotional experiences.
